verdict.rationale: Lovable documents its own MCP server that lets an external AI agent create projects, send messages, inspect code and deploy apps. That is a real programmatic surface covering core UI actions, but nothing shows full parity with the UI. The 'Lovable API' Build with URL feature only pre-fills prompt links, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: a documented public REST/HTTP API, evidence of parity for settings, domains, database, security scans, collaboration and billing, published API reference/spec, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: your AI agent can create projects, send messages to Lovable, inspect code, deploy apps, and more, all without leaving the client you're already working in
The Lovable API Build with URL feature lets you create links that open Lovable with a prompt already written
